result.summary: The main visual issue is an incorrect bottom-navigation selection state: the Home feed is displayed, but Profile is highlighted as active.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights the Profile icon and label in green, while the visible screen is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, search, restaurant categories, and restaurant lists). This creates a confusing and inconsistent navigation state.
issues.suggestion: Mark Home as the active tab on this screen, and reserve the green active styling for Profile only when the profile screen is actually displayed.

issues.description: The inactive bottom-navigation icons and labels use very light gray on white, making them visually faint and potentially difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the inactive navigation color to meet contrast requirements while retaining a clear distinction from the active green state.
